summary: ITER-189 PAMM Batch 1 (Trade Verdict engine · Emergency op-state hierarchy · Dual authorization) — full-stack verified. Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iter189_pamm_verdict_states_dualauth.py 9/9 PASS in 9.15s (approve/reduce/reject spectrum, risk_reduced halves risk, escalation+deescalation+locked, automation-cannot-deescalate PermissionError, e-stop→emergency_flatten→clear→new_trades_paused, risk breach escalates, loosening needs 2nd admin + same-admin 403 + dup 409 + double-decide 409 + ChangeApproved event, unlock via dual-auth, reject leaves state untouched). PAMM regression iter185-188 48/48 PASS in 36.96s (no regressions). Frontend E2E on external preview URL (admin@stoicaibot.com): /managed loads, pamm-op-state-badge='RUNNING', verdict-risk-input=0.30 + verdict-check-button → verdict-result='APPROVE → 0.3%' with factor chips (daily_loss_pct ×1, weekly ×1, monthly ×1, drawdown ×1, exposure ×1, correlated ×1). Escalate via pamm-op-state-select→new_trades_paused + pamm-op-state-apply → badge='NEW TRADES PAUSED' + 'BLOCKED: new_trades_paused' pill visible + trading_allowed=False. De-escalate to running → step-up dialog opens with correct 2FA enrollment message 'Two-factor authentication must be enabled before this action. Enroll under Settings → Security first.' (admin has no TOTP — expected, not a bug); cancel closes dialog and state stays paused. ChangeRequestsPanel dual-auth verified: admin@trading.bot loosens daily_loss_pct threshold 3.5→8.0 via PUT /api/pamm/programs/{id}/risk-limits → 200 pending_approval=true, change_id=chg_ea9ca44a1d, message 'a SECOND admin must approve'. Loaded /managed as admin@stoicaibot.com → pamm-change-requests-panel shows '1 PENDING · Loosen risk limits · loosens: daily_loss_pct' with APPROVE/REJECT buttons (no change-own- banner since requester differs). OpStateChanged + ChangeRequested + StrategyPaused + StrategyResumed events all appear in EVENT STREAM as expected. Cleanup: rejected the pending request; op_state restored to running; trading_allowed=True.
critical_code_review_comments: verdict.py SOFT_ZONE=0.5 / MIN_FACTOR=0.1 constants are hard-coded — consider exposing per-program (or per-partner) tuning knobs down the road (e.g., some programs may want a wider safe zone).

Frontend VerdictTester renders factor chips as raw text 'daily_loss_pct ×1' — okay for admins but the human-readable LIMIT_LABELS map already exists in the same file for the RISK ENGINE table. Reuse it in the chip labels for consistency ('Daily loss cap % ×1').
ChangeRequestsPanel: expiry is set at 48h server-side but the UI does not surface the countdown. Add a 'expires in Nh' hint so approvers see urgency.

OpStateControl select shows raw enum values (running / risk_reduced / new_trades_paused / close_risk_only / emergency_flatten / locked). Consider grouping into 'Escalate' vs 'De-escalate' subsections so operators cannot accidentally pick 'locked' from the dropdown (LOCKED is an unrecoverable-without-dual-auth trap door).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of required data-testids present and behaviorally correct (pamm-op-state-badge, pamm-op-state-select, pamm-op-state-apply, verdict-risk-input, verdict-check-button, verdict-result, pamm-change-requests-panel, change-approve-{cid}, change-reject-{cid}, trading BLOCKED pill, step-up 2FA enrollment dialog)

test_credentials: Primary admin admin@stoicaibot.com / admin123 (browser). Secondary admin admin@trading.bot / admin123 (curl to seed the dual-auth pending request). STEP_UP_BYPASS_TOKEN + RATE_LIMIT_BYPASS_TOKEN read from /app/backend/.env for out-of-pytest raw requests.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates and cleans up its own throwaway programs (vrd-*, ops-*, da-*). For the UI dual-auth check, a temporary pending change request (chg_ea9ca44a1d, loosen daily_loss_pct 3.5→8.0 on Alpha Managed Fund) was created and rejected at end of run. Alpha Managed Fund restored to op_state=running / trading_allowed=True. Nothing left dangling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alpha Managed Fund program_id=pgm_c270193fed remains in op_state=running, trading_allowed=True, no pending change requests. Dual-auth end-to-end works: use TWO admin accounts (admin@trading.bot as requester, admin@stoicaibot.com as approver) or vice versa — same-admin approve returns 403, second-admin approve applies and emits ChangeApproved. In-browser step-up dialog for both preview admins shows 2FA enrollment message (they have no TOTP) — this is CORRECT product behavior for de-escalating op-state / saving loosening risk limits / unlocking LOCKED. To exercise a full browser step-up flow, enroll TOTP for one admin (POST /api/auth/2fa/enroll + verify-enroll), otherwise use the STEP_UP_BYPASS header (pytest-only). Op-state hierarchy: running → risk_reduced → new_trades_paused → close_risk_only → emergency_flatten → locked; automation may escalate but never de-escalate (raises PermissionError); leaving LOCKED requires kind='unlock' change request with dual approval; op-state POST from LOCKED returns 409. Verdict engine: SOFT_ZONE=0.5 (utilization <50% costs no scaling), MIN_FACTOR=0.1 (utilization >=95% ⇒ REJECT); risk_reduced state additionally halves approved_risk_pct.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. External-review Batch 1 implementation is behaviorally correct across API + UI; step-up 2FA enrollment prompt on de-escalate / risk-limit-save is a feature (documented) and not a defect.
